title: Bill Moore interviewed T. Townsend Brown
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Bill Moore interviewed T. Townsend Brown, about 1970s-1980s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You know, Bill Moore interviewed interviewed T. Towns and Brown.

plain: A writer and researcher named Greg Bishop told podcast host Jesse Michels that Bill Moore, a UFO writer and researcher, interviewed T. Townsend Brown, an inventor known for work on unusual electrical forces, sometime in the 1970s or 1980s. Bishop links this to a book called The Cosmic Conspiracy. It matters because it would connect Moore directly to one of the central figures in claims about secret propulsion.
